# Predict Method for Temporal Disaggregation

Compute the disaggregated or interpolated (and extrapolated) high
frequency series of a temporal disaggregation.

## Usage

``` r
# S3 method for class 'td'
predict(object, ...)
```

## Arguments

- object:

  an object of class `"td"`, usually, a result of a call to
  [`td()`](http://cynkra.github.io/tempdisagg/reference/td.md).

- ...:

  further arguments passed to or from other methods.

## Value

`summary.td` returns a vector or a `"ts"` object, containing the
disaggregated or interpolated high frequency series of a temporal
disaggregation.

## See also

[`td()`](http://cynkra.github.io/tempdisagg/reference/td.md) for the
main function for temporal disaggregation.

## Examples

``` r
data(swisspharma)

mod1 <- td(sales.a ~ imports.q + exports.q)
predict(mod1)
```
